hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}" || exit 0; [ -f apm.lock.yaml ] && command -v apm >/dev/null || exit 0; (sed -n 's/^ *- \(\.[^ :]*\)$/\1/p' apm.lock.yaml | while read -r p; do [ -e "$p" ] || exit 1; done) && exit 0; apm install --frozen >&2
